mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpRqContractLisPopList*/ SELECT B.CONTRACT_NO, B.CONTRACT_SEQ, B.DESCRIPTION, B.SPECIFICATION, B.MAKER_NAME, B.AGENT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=B.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, B.UNIT_PRICE, B.BUYER_ITEM_NO, B.SPECIFICATION, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE=B.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME, B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, DECODE(B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, 'ALL', '전체', (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE)) AS BELOW_COMORG_NAME, B.LIST_PRICE , ROUND((B.UNIT_PRICE-B.LIST_PRICE )/B.UNIT_PRICE*100,2)||'%' AS PRICE_RATE , A.UNIT_MEASURE , B.MAKER_CODE , B.ORIGIN_CODE FROM ICOMBYIT A, ICOMCQDT B WHERE A.BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=#{st_buyer} AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO=#{st_buyer_item_no} AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO=B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = #{st_buyer} AND B.STATUS ^='D' AND A.STATUS ^='D'
